title: 第六十七章 老夫林玄今日没人可以活着第六十六章 心玲别怕伯父带你杀人
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 震耳的枪声早已经将工厂内部的其他高手给惊动了。
三五成群的瀛溟国高手，直接从房间内快速冲出。
但这边才刚刚冲出，根本没看清是怎么回事呢。
就感觉到一股排山倒海般的恐怖力量，瞬间袭来。
他们眼前一黑，几乎同一时间吐血塌软，骨骼、内脏统统粉碎，身躯好似失去了支撑一样，直接扑倒在地，死的不能再死。
林玄单手抱着林心玲，面色冷漠，一边走，一边挥手。
达到丹劲后期之后。
他的力量收发随心，更加得心应手。
每一击打出，都有龙象之力。
杀起人来，无声无息，防不胜防。
整个过程，艺术、暴力、美观。
不像是在杀人。
倒像是一场表演。
从始至终，都没有任何人能叫得出来。
也没有任何人能来得及通知同伴。
基本都是出来就死，出来就倒。
有的人还在房间内正准备往外走，就被林玄随手一挥，隔着墙壁，就给震死在了屋子中。
这一刻。
林玄当真是把劲力运用到了极致。
一路走，一路杀。
血流满地，尸体扑倒。
从未有任何时候，他杀机如此旺盛。
工厂地下二层。
宽敞的大厅内。
所有骨干都汇聚到了这里。
一个个屏住呼吸，低下头来，气氛严肃，一动不动。
在他们最中间。
一具脑海消失，惨不忍睹的尸体，躺在那里。
刚刚被人从外面抬回来。
从这尸体身上的衣服、手腕上的文身、手指上的指纹，等多方面因素来看，这就是服部大人！
也是工厂之内唯二的一位‘影级’高手。
但他竟然死了！
面目全非！
颅骨碎裂！
堪称惨不忍睹！
九菊玄海满脸阴沉，从一侧缓缓走来。
所有人都躬身行礼。
“玄海前辈...”
“那只西洋浪人呢？”
content_en:
The deafening gunshots had already alerted other experts inside the factory.
Groups of Yingming Kingdom masters quickly rushed out of the room.
But they had just rushed out and didn't see what was going on.
I felt an overwhelming terrifying force coming over me instantly.
Their vision went dark, and they vomited blood and collapsed almost at the same time. Their bones and internal organs were all shattered, and their bodies seemed to have lost support. They fell directly to the ground, unable to die anymore.
Lin Xuan held Lin Xinling with one hand, looking indifferent, waving as he walked.
After reaching the late stage of Danjin.
He can send and receive power at will, making it even more convenient.
Every blow is struck with the power of the dragon and elephant.
Killing people is silent and impossible to prevent.
The whole process is artistic, violent and beautiful.
It's not like he's killing people.
It's more like a performance.
From beginning to end, no one could scream.
No one had time to inform their companions.
Basically, you will die when you come out, and you will collapse when you come out.
Some people were still in the room and were about to go out, but Lin Xuan waved his hand and were shocked to death in the room through the wall.
This moment.
Lin Xuan really used his strength to the extreme.
Go all the way and kill all the way.
Blood flowed all over the ground, and bodies fell to the ground.
Never before had he been so murderous.
...
The second underground floor of the factory.
Inside the spacious hall.
All the backbones have gathered here.
Everyone held their breath and lowered their heads. The atmosphere was serious and motionless.
In the very middle of them.
A corpse whose mind had disappeared and was so miserable lay there.
He had just been carried back from outside.
Judging from the clothes on the corpse, the tattoos on the wrists, the fingerprints on the fingers, and many other factors, we can tell that this is Hattori-sama!
He is also the only ‘Shadow Level’ master in the factory.
But he died!
Unrecognizable!
Skull shattered!
It’s terrible!
Jiuju Xuanhai had a gloomy face and walked slowly from one side.
Everyone bowed and saluted.
"Senior Xuanhai..."
"Where's the rogue?"
title_en: Chapter 67: Old husband Lin Xuan, no one can survive today Chapter 66: Xinling, don’t be afraid that your uncle will lead you to kill people
